tools.name: hyresuppskattning
tools.description: Estimate the monthly short-term rental (Airbnb) booking income for a home in Sweden, from property type, bedrooms and postcode. Returns a rounded monthly range in SEK, a link to Norli's full report, and whether Norli manages this type of home in the area.

tools.name: sok_guider
tools.description: Search Norli's published guides on renting out a home via Airbnb in Sweden: tax, insurance, pricing, cleaning, renting to companies, and guides per area. Returns titles, links and excerpts.

tools.name: omraden
tools.description: Which areas of Sweden Norli takes on, with the property types per area and links to Norli's published area guides.
